shared_elements: standing anthropomorphic figure with limbs extended
radiating/fan-like element (rayed motif in A, feathered wing in B)
justification: Both surfaces depict upright anthropomorphic figures seen essentially in profile, and each includes a splayed, radiating fan-like form (a rayed motif in A, a carefully feathered wing in B), but this is about as generic as figural imagery gets. A shows many tiny, stick-like, gesturing figures scattered across two horizontal registers with no clear attributes or interactions, whereas B shows a single monumental, anatomically detailed bird-headed winged being with a raised arm and a handled bucket, filling the whole field; the conventions of drawing (crude schematic silhouettes versus modelled musculature and patterned plumage) share nothing.
